text_block_list.name: Magazine Reporter
text_block_list.text: E-excuse me! Can I have a few minutes of your time? I'm an editor for Kawaii-Girl magazine…

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Oh! I know that magazine! Everyone in my class loves it!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hm… But I'm pretty busy and have to get to training…

text_block_list.name: Magazine Reporter
text_block_list.text: No—wait! It's just for a snapshot on the street corner. It'll only take five minutes!

text_block_list.name: Magazine Reporter
text_block_list.text: …Oh, you're so adorable. But a few snapshots aren't enough to convey your true cuteness!

text_block_list.name: Magazine Reporter
text_block_list.text: You need your own feature! I'm going to speak with the head editor immediately! Please give me just a little more of your time!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hm… Could you include my socials with the pictures?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Okay, then… Just a little longer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even though she ends up skipping training, the magazine feature causes Curren Chan's followers to skyrocket.
